statement: Georgia Tech reports housing occupancy of 9,892, including university and Greek housing.
reason_no_rate: The table does not resolve whether its married-housing row counts students, households or other occupants. This figure is retained as documented occupancy, but is not treated as a verified student headcount. The international reporting footprint also remains unmatched.

statement: University Housing and Dining reports 10,018 residents during spring 2024.
reason_no_rate: This is an actual resident figure, not a bed count. Its student-only definition and full geographic coverage remain unresolved; it is also a spring observation rather than the fall snapshot used for the main comparison.
source_title: University of Texas at Austin, 2023–2024 Learning and Outcomes Report

statement: Graduate housing contains 2,808 graduate students, including Graduate Junction.
reason_no_rate: This covers graduate students in that housing inventory, not all student residents. Undergraduate residents and graduate advisers in undergraduate communities require separate reconciliation. The report also has a one-student discrepancy in its separately listed undergraduate subtotal; nonstudents are reported separately.
source_title: Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Graduate Housing Advisory Committee annual update

statement: Graduate housing contains 2,839 graduate students, including Graduate Junction.
reason_no_rate: The figure excludes undergraduate students and does not establish the number of graduate advisers living in undergraduate communities. It is a documented student population, but only part of the population required for an institution-wide housing rate.
source_title: Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Graduate Housing Advisory Committee annual update

statement: The university reports 5,994 undergraduate students in campus housing in its College House section.
reason_no_rate: This is an undergraduate figure, not a complete count of all student residents. The section expressly focuses on College Houses while also identifying separate Greek housing; the complete population corresponding to the reported residential crimes is not established.
source_title: University of Pennsylvania 2026 Annual Security and Fire Safety Report
